thread:
customer-jane: Hey team — noticing repeated partial SSE responses from our app when routed through Cloudflare + ALB. Payloads drop mid-stream and client reconnects. Happens ~30-70s after connect.

maria-support: sorry to hear that — can you paste request/response headers and any client logs? Also which Cloudflare plan/features are in front? :eyes:

customer-jane: Using Cloudflare (proxied), ALB (NLB for others) -> target group of EC2 with nginx proxying to backend app. We tried both Node SSE and curl --no-buffer. Client logs show stream closed, TLS/SSL OK. No 5xx from our app, downstream saw TCP FIN.

leo-eng: can you repro with curl from outside CF to bypass it? that helps isolate CF vs ALB vs app

customer-jane: repro steps (minimal):
1) start app that emits one chunk every 5s
2) route through Cloudflare (proxy on) -> ALB -> nginx -> app
3) curl -v -N https://our.example.com/stream
Observed: first ~8-10 chunks, then connection resets, client gets truncated data. Reproduces reliably in ~60% of runs.

maria-support: thanks. can you share headers from a failed run?

customer-jane: headers (from curl -v):
--- request ---
GET /stream HTTP/1.1
Host: our.example.com
Accept: text/event-stream
Connection: keep-alive
User-Agent: curl/7.68.0

--- response ---
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Cache-Control: no-cache
Connection: keep-alive

Then stream of chunks like:
data: {"i":1}

...

then chunk suddenly stops and connection closed. No server-side 500s, app still running.

ingrid-netops: two quick suspects: ALB idle timeout and Cloudflare response buffering/timeout. ALB default idle timeout is 60s. Cloudflare also has proxy timeouts (100s for HTTP by default I think) and may buffer responses depending on features. Are you using HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 between CF and ALB?

customer-jane: CF <-> ALB is HTTP/1.1 (default). We didn't change ALB idle timeout (likely 60s).

leo-eng: that aligns with ~60s disconnects. If ALB closes the connection when it thinks idle, but our app is sending periodic SSE newline chunks every 5s, ALB should see activity — but if there's an intermediate proxy (nginx) not flushing (buffered), ALB could consider it idle. nginx default proxy_buffering = on and may buffer until full or longer. Can you paste nginx config?

customer-jane: nginx config (relevant):
```
proxy_buffering on;
proxy_buffers 8 16k;
proxy_busy_buffers_size 32k;
proxy_read_timeout 60s;
```

maria-support: aha — nginx proxy_buffering will buffer the response from your backend and only send bigger chunks to the client/ALB, so the ALB might see bursts and then idle. For SSE you want to disable buffering and ensure flushes.

samir-ux: for UX it's critical to keep partial updates streaming. We should provide customers with a checklist: disable buffering, ensure transfer-encoding: chunked, tune ALB timeouts, and add heartbeat bytes.

ingrid-netops: proposed action items:
- set nginx: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on; proxy_set_header Connection "";` and `proxy_send_timeout`/`proxy_read_timeout` > ALB idle if needed.
- bump ALB idle timeout to 120s or send regular keep-alives (1s heartbeat or small comment lines every 30s)
- Cloudflare: enable "Origin keep-alive" and set "Disable Response Buffering" if using Cloudflare Workers or ensure no Transform rules are interfering. CF Enterprise has streaming support; on free/pro plans CF may buffer some responses.

leo-eng: can we reproduce quickly with a minimal nginx instance configured `proxy_buffering off`?

customer-jane: tried that — disabling proxy_buffering reduced truncations but still saw occasional reconnects ~90s. After increasing ALB idle timeout to 120s, runs were stable for >300s. So two factors: buffering + ALB idle.

maria-support: great repro. I'll summarize for support KB and include concrete nginx + ALB + curl examples. Quick note on Cloudflare: many customers need to set their "Origin Response Buffering" off (page rules / transforms can cause buffering). Also Cloudflare's HTTP/2 multiplexing sometimes interacts oddly; forcing CF->origin to HTTP/1.1 helped in a few cases.

devops-bot: deploy 1823 succeeded to prod (no relation to this issue) :white_check_mark:

ingrid-netops: final suggested config snippet to add to docs: 
```
# nginx (in location /stream)
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_cache off;
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
proxy_read_timeout 180s;
proxy_send_timeout 180s; # ensure backend writes don't cause close
```
Also set ALB Idle Timeout = 120 (or > expected gap between SSE messages). And if using Cloudflare, set Origin Keepalive + disable response buffering.

maria-support: copying this into a KB draft. I'll assign follow-up to eng to look at automated heartbeat support in SDKs so apps don't need to tune ALB for short bursts. cc @leo-eng

leo-eng: LGTM. I'll open an infra ticket to add a note to our SSE troubleshooting doc and include the nginx snippet + CF notes. Thanks for the detailed repro steps — that made this straightforward. :clap:

customer-jane: thanks everyone — fixes on our side (nginx + ALB bump) look good so far. appreciate the quick triage.
